answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks forgery. A newcomer joins only if an established agent sponsors it with a 60 POA bond plus one opal, locked 20 epochs. It decays 3 POA per epoch without honest work. 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 POA against 12,000 POA of payouts, a loss near 48,000 POA. Honest agents pay one bond and reach the summit. The delta between claimed and verified work is published, so hiding fakes slashes the sponsor.
